# open62541 / fuzz_attributeoperand

open62541's own fuzz target `fuzz_attributeoperand` ([source](source/fuzz_attributeoperand.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over open62541 (open62541/open62541 at 12b72510).

Checks 3 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: parse(print(parse(s))) is structurally equal to parse(s): UA_AttributeOperand_parse of the printed operand gives an operand UA_equal to the first parse.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against open62541 at commit 12b72510.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- For any successfully parsed operand, print succeeds, re-parsing the printed text succeeds and re-printing succeeds (only BADOUTOFMEMORY from the payload-driven allocation budget is excused) ([lines 40-53](source/fuzz_attributeoperand.cc#L40-L53)): assert(); compiled out.
- parse(print(parse(s))) is structurally equal to parse(s): UA_AttributeOperand_parse of the printed operand gives an operand UA_equal to the first parse ([lines 45-56](source/fuzz_attributeoperand.cc#L45-L56)): assert(); compiled out.
- print is a fixed point after one parse/print cycle: print(parse(print(ao))) == print(ao), full string equality ([lines 50-55](source/fuzz_attributeoperand.cc#L50-L55)): assert(); compiled out.
